content.json:
# VoiceBot Operations and Business Dashboard

End-to-end call health, Azure realtime reliability, booking funnel, and ROI telemetry.

content.query:
let VoiceBotEvents = customEvents
| extend eventName = case(isnotempty(tostring(name)), tostring(name), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"])), tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"]), tostring(customDimensions.eventType))
| extend callId = case(isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.callId)), tostring(customDimensions.callId), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.callSID)), tostring(customDimensions.callSID), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.callSid)), tostring(customDimensions.callSid), tostring(customDimensions.sid));
let CallSummaries = VoiceBotEvents
| where eventName == "call_summary" and isnotempty(callId)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by callId
| extend outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome), revenue = coalesce(todouble(customDimensions.estimatedRevenueUsd), 0.0), cost = coalesce(todouble(customDimensions.estimatedCostUsd), 0.0), bookingLinkSent = tobool(customDimensions.bookingLinkSent), bookingCompleted = tobool(customDimensions.bookingCompleted);
let CompletionPerCall = VoiceBotEvents
| where eventName in ("booking_completed_webhook", "call_summary") and isnotempty(callId)
| extend outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome), bookingCompleted = tobool(customDimensions.bookingCompleted), completionRevenue = coalesce(todouble(customDimensions.estimatedRevenueUsd), 0.0)
| where eventName == "booking_completed_webhook" or outcome == "booking_completed" or bookingCompleted
| summarize completionRevenueUsd = max(completionRevenue) by callId;
let completedBookingCount = toscalar(CompletionPerCall | summarize count());
let completedRevenueTotalUsd = toscalar(CompletionPerCall | summarize sum(completionRevenueUsd));
CallSummaries
| summarize totalCalls = dcount(callId), bookingLinksSent = dcountif(callId, bookingLinkSent or outcome == "booking_link_sent"), transfers = dcountif(callId, outcome == "transferred"), abandoned = dcountif(callId, outcome == "abandoned"), nonCompletionRevenueUsd = sum(iif(outcome == "booking_completed" or bookingCompleted, 0.0, revenue)), estimatedCostUsd = sum(cost)
| extend completedBookings = completedBookingCount, estimatedRevenueUsd = nonCompletionRevenueUsd + completedRevenueTotalUsd, estimatedGrossProfitUsd = estimatedRevenueUsd - estimatedCostUsd
| extend bookingCompletionRate = todouble(completedBookings) / iif(totalCalls == 0, 1.0, todouble(totalCalls)), bookingLinkRate = todouble(bookingLinksSent) / iif(totalCalls == 0, 1.0, todouble(totalCalls)), roiRatio = iif(estimatedCostUsd > 0, estimatedGrossProfitUsd / estimatedCostUsd, real(null))
| project totalCalls, completedBookings, bookingLinksSent, transfers, abandoned, estimatedRevenueUsd, estimatedCostUsd, estimatedGrossProfitUsd, bookingCompletionRate, bookingLinkRate, roiRatio
content.title: Executive Scorecard

| extend callId = case(isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.callId)), tostring(customDimensions.callId), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.callSID)), tostring(customDimensions.callSID), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.callSid)), tostring(customDimensions.callSid), tostring(customDimensions.sid));
VoiceBotEvents
| where eventName in ("telecom_status_received", "telecom_status_terminal", "realtime_session_created", "realtime_connection_error", "realtime_service_error", "realtime_connection_closed", "realtime_reconnected", "realtime_reconnection_failed", "reconnect_hold_music_started", "reconnect_hold_music_stopped", "reconnection_failed_hangup", "turn_created", "user_speech_started", "speech_window_transcribed", "response_latency", "speech_started", "speech_playback_started", "speech_emitted", "speech_completed", "turn_closed", "response_timeout", "token_budget_exceeded", "booking_intent_detected", "booking_link_requested", "booking_link_delivery_sent", "booking_link_delivery_failed", "booking_link_sent", "booking_link_failed", "booking_completed_webhook", "booking_webhook_orphaned", "handover_triggered", "handover_transfer_scheduled", "agent_availability_checked", "warm_transfer_started", "cold_transfer_started", "transfer_request_accepted", "transfer_request_failed", "agent_leg_answered", "agent_leg_accepted", "agent_leg_rejected", "warm_transfer_bridge_confirmed", "warm_transfer_failed", "call_transferred", "hangup_triggered", "call_finalization_started", "call_finalization_completed", "call_finalization_degraded", "call_summary")

content.query:
let VoiceBotEvents = customEvents
| extend eventName = case(isnotempty(tostring(name)), tostring(name), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"])), tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"]), tostring(customDimensions.eventType))
| extend callId = case(isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.callId)), tostring(customDimensions.callId), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.callSID)), tostring(customDimensions.callSID), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.callSid)), tostring(customDimensions.callSid), tostring(customDimensions.sid));
let FunnelEvents = VoiceBotEvents
| where eventName in ("booking_intent_detected", "booking_link_requested", "booking_link_delivery_sent", "booking_link_sent")
| extend stage = case(eventName == "booking_intent_detected", "1 Intent", eventName == "booking_link_requested", "2 Link requested", eventName == "booking_link_delivery_sent", "3 Delivery sent", eventName == "booking_link_sent", "4 Link sent", "Other")
| project timestamp, callId, stage;
let CompletionEvents = VoiceBotEvents
| where eventName in ("booking_completed_webhook", "call_summary") and isnotempty(callId)
| extend outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome), bookingCompleted = tobool(customDimensions.bookingCompleted)
| where eventName == "booking_completed_webhook" or outcome == "booking_completed" or bookingCompleted
| summarize timestamp = max(timestamp) by callId
| extend stage = "5 Booked";
union FunnelEvents, CompletionEvents
| where isnotempty(callId)
| summarize calls = dcount(callId) by stage, bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc, stage asc
content.title: Booking Funnel by Hour

content.query:
let VoiceBotEvents = customEvents
| extend eventName = case(isnotempty(tostring(name)), tostring(name), isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"])), tostring(customDimensions["microsoft.custom_event.name"]), tostring(customDimensions.eventType))

let IntentCalls = VoiceBotEvents
| where eventName in ("booking_intent_detected", "booking_link_requested", "booking_link_delivery_sent", "booking_link_sent") and isnotempty(callId)
| summarize intentAt = min(timestamp) by callId;
let CompletionCalls = VoiceBotEvents
| where eventName in ("booking_completed_webhook", "call_summary") and isnotempty(callId)
| extend outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome), bookingCompleted = tobool(customDimensions.bookingCompleted)
| where eventName == "booking_completed_webhook" or outcome == "booking_completed" or bookingCompleted
| summarize completedAt = max(timestamp) by callId;
IntentCalls
| join kind=leftouter CompletionCalls on callId
| summarize intentCalls = dcount(callId), completedBookings = dcountif(callId, isnotempty(completedAt)) by bin(intentAt, 1h)
| extend intentCompletionRate = todouble(completedBookings) / iif(intentCalls == 0, 1.0, todouble(intentCalls))
| project timestamp = intentAt, intentCalls, completedBookings, intentCompletionRate
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Booking Intent Cohort Conversion

let VoiceBotEvents = customEvents

let CallSummaries = VoiceBotEvents
| where eventName == "call_summary" and isnotempty(callId)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by callId
| extend persona = iff(isempty(tostring(customDimensions.persona)), "unknown", tostring(customDimensions.persona)), outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome), revenue = coalesce(todouble(customDimensions.estimatedRevenueUsd), 0.0), cost = coalesce(todouble(customDimensions.estimatedCostUsd), 0.0), bookingLinkSent = tobool(customDimensions.bookingLinkSent), bookingCompleted = tobool(customDimensions.bookingCompleted);
let CompletionPerCall = VoiceBotEvents

| summarize completionRevenueUsd = max(completionRevenue) by callId;
CallSummaries
| join kind=leftouter CompletionPerCall on callId
| extend completedBooking = isnotnull(completionRevenueUsd)

| extend revenueUsd = nonCompletionRevenueUsd + completedRevenueUsd, grossProfitUsd = revenueUsd - costUsd, avgCostPerCallUsd = iif(calls == 0, 0.0, costUsd / todouble(calls))
| extend bookingRate = todouble(bookings) / iif(calls == 0, 1.0, todouble(calls)), roiRatio = iif(costUsd > 0, grossProfitUsd / costUsd, real(null))

CallDaily
